title: 12 PanneauDesChevaux(PartieDroite)CervidéLionChevauxEtCoupleDeLions.jpg
author: Claude Valette
description: Horse Panel (right). Wooden charcoal drawings with fading, flint scraping. Quite to the right, a couple of lions: the male (front) stretches out the neck, the female (behind) lowers its back train and shows teeth. Pont d'Arc cave (copy of the Chauvet Cave), paleontology (the male has no mane, the drawing informs about morphology and behavior of these extinct animals).
